title: Rounding Error
author: Hallam Knight
tagline: A small miscalculation. A very big discovery.
blurb:
The TSV Meridian is humanity's first deep-space exploration vessel, built around a revolutionary drive that bends the rules of physics: the Shear Drive.

When a routine test jump reveals a persistent 3% rounding error, it's dismissed as a quirk of new technology. But the anomaly doesn't go away. It gets louder.

Tasked with a follow-up mission, the Meridian's crew pushes further than anyone planned, and finds something that shouldn't be there. A signal. A structure. A question.

What begins as a technical investigation quickly becomes something far larger: evidence that humanity's first steps into interstellar space may not be as unnoticed as they thought.

The universe is not empty. It's been listening.
